top_choice_rationale: Palladium-catalyzed C-N cross-coupling by Buchwald and Hartwig is the most secure case on maturity, attribution and chemical content together. Controlling amido-palladium intermediates and the difficult C-N reductive elimination by ligand design is a different mechanistic problem from the 2010 C-C couplings, three decades of independent use confirm it, and the two parallel originators allow a clean two-name allocation. Targeted protein degradation (P002/P003) has larger biological impact but no approved degrader and a contested third name; the Solexa pair (P004) is mature but its credit is contested and the chemistry-versus-genomics objection remains.
